exchanges: first run club since my cold, legs were jelly
Coming back after being sick is always rough. How far did you go?
8k. kenji kept slowing down for me which was nice of him
That's a good captain move. Nobody likes being left behind on a comeback run.
hes the best captain we've had. his uncle hiro runs with us too, hes 64 and faster than me lol
That's impressive. Some older runners are incredibly consistent.
he retird a few yrs ago, he was a pilot for 30 yrs. says running is the only thing that gives him the same rush
That's a long career in the air. No wonder he likes a sport with that kind of freedom.
and his great uncle tadashi does the water station every sat, hes like 85
That's lovely, a real family affair. Water station volunteers are underrated.
tadashi was a fisherman his whole life out in bc, he tells the best storys
I can imagine. A lifetime on the water must give you plenty of material.
adaeze smoked everyone again today shes training for chicago next fall
Sounds like she's in great shape for it. Is it her first marathon?
her third. she wants to qualify for boston
That's an ambitious goal. Those qualifying times are tough.
liam our coach brought energy balls he made, hes vegetarian so theyre all dates and oats
Homemade energy balls are a nice touch. Dates are good natural fuel.
they were kinda gross ngl
Ha, they can be an acquired taste.
theres a new girl rosalind she brought her dog, a husky named juno
That breed makes a great running partner. They have endless energy.
juno was dragging her up the hills it was hilarious
That's one way to train hills.
my calves r so tight now. should i stretch tonite or wait til tmrw
A gentle stretch tonight is fine, and some light rolling helps too. Save deep stretching for when you're warmed up.
i dont have a foam roller
A tennis ball or a rolling pin works in a pinch.
lol a rolling pin ok
It sounds silly, but it works.
oh wait liam isnt vegetarian hes vegan, he said no eggs or dairy or anything. i got that wrong
Got it. That explains the dates-and-oats recipe.
ya he wont even eat honey
That's pretty strict. He must plan his meals carefully.
kenji is organizing a 10k for charity in the spring, for the childrens hospital
That's a great cause. Is the whole club running it?
most of us. hiro wants to do it in under 50 min
That's quick at any age. He'll probably manage it.
probly lol
Sounds like he's the one to beat.
ok random q is it bad to run with a cold or just after one
Running with mild head-cold symptoms is usually fine at an easy pace, but if it's in your chest or you have a fever, rest. Ease back in afterward.
it was just my nose so i think im ok
Then you're probably fine. Just keep the pace easy for a week.
rosalind invited me to do a trail run sunday
That sounds fun. Trails are easier on the legs too.
shes a paramedic so she works weird shifts, sunday is her only day off
Shift work makes days off precious. Nice of her to spend it on a run with you.
ya shes really nice i think were gonna be friends
It's great when a club turns into friendships.
